corpus_definition: Frozen offline corpus of 43 unmodified public JAR archives distributed by Debian packages, plus two Apache Ant builder archives.
selection_rule: Enumerate all unordered pairs among the 43 bundled study providers and retain each pair sharing at least one entry outside META-INF after excluding META-INF/MANIFEST.MF from build interpretation.
scope_note: The corpus is a frozen collision-bearing sample, not a statistically representative sample of Android or Java builds.
